title: plantago canescens var. cylindrica
intro: Plantago canescens var. cylindrica, commonly known as hoary plantain, is a type of flowering plant in the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat a variety of health issues, including digestive problems, wounds, and skin conditions, due to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The health benefits of Plantago canescens var. cylindrica include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and exhibiting antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and polysaccharides, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
